prompt.value: Select the correct code snippet that prints a backslash character to the console.

explanation.value:
Since \ is an escape character, \' will mess up with the closing quotes in the print function. So, to
print the backslash, we have to escape the backslash itself! The way to do it is to add one more backslash so that
Python renders that as a backslash character. You can convince yourself that double backslash is indeed a
character: print(len('\\'))
